newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE trades busiest May, Euroswiss sets record.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE trades busiest May, Euroswiss sets record.

text.p: The London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) said on Tuesday it traded 16.6 million futures and options contracts in May, its busiest May on record.
Volume was up 33 percent on May 1996. Average daily volume totalled 829,866 contracts, representing average daily nominal turnover of 163 billion stg.
Year-to-date, LIFFEs volume has totalled 83.95 million contracts, up 19 percent on the same period last year.
In the past month, three month Euroswiss futures contracts set a new montly record of 418,953 contracts, beating the previous monthly record of 387,189 contracts.

Japanese government bond futures set a monthly record of 124,033 contracts. The new link with the Chicago Board of Trade, started in May 9, saw a total of 26,873 T-bond futures and options contracts traded.
